summary: Fetch-based video list API. getVideoList({lang='zh-cn', cate, page=1, pageSize=10}) builds '/api/content/info_video?lang=<lang>&page=<page>&pageSize=<pageSize>' (plus '&cate=<cate>' when given), requests it from SiteConfig.api_server_host (https://endfield.gryphline.com) with fetch, and returns body.data when the HTTP status is 2xx/3xx and body.code === 0; otherwise it throws Error('Failed to fetch video list').
